channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: 9 deputados investigados no STF têm aumento de R$ 33,9 milhões em bens
item.description: Nine federal deputies under investigation at the STF increased their assets by R$33.9 million between the last election and 2024, according to a UOL survey. The investigations suspect embezzlement of parliamentary amendments and funds. The asset growth raises concerns about the origin of the resources.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se une a 'inimigos' de Lula como estratégia para Nordeste
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign focuses on the Northeast, strengthening opponents of Lula (PT) and candidates backed by him, even if it means not integrating local rallies. The strategy aims to consolidate state-level support without relying on direct alliances with regional leaders.

item.title: QG de Lula vai ao TSE contra ação 'coordenada e inautêntica' sobre preços
item.description: Lula's campaign requests a TSE investigation into suspected mass dissemination of inauthentic material, including scripts and identical images, promoted by profiles linked to PL leaders criticizing food prices.

item.title: Lula vai aparecer no horário eleitoral com livros que leu na prisão
item.description: Lula recorded new campaign ads for the electoral time slot, to air starting August 28, featuring a bookshelf with over 40 books he read during his 2018-2019 imprisonment in Curitiba. The recordings were made at the campaign's new headquarters in Brasília, covering topics like the 'Blusinhas Tax' and works on history, sociology, and historical figures like Nelson Mandela and Fidel Castro.

item.title: Nome de operação da PF contra Lulinha incomoda entorno de Lula
item.description: The Federal Police named a phase of investigation against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and Roberta Luchsinger 'Operation Elli,' causing discomfort around Lula due to a perceived reference to the phrase 'Faz o L.' The operation investigates alleged money laundering and capital laundering crimes involving businessmen and lobbyists.

item.title: Kassab reage a ausências no primeiro debate presidencial de 2026
item.description: Gilberto Kassab criticized the absence of Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro and Romeu Zema from the first 2026 presidential debate, attributing the no-show of the first two to a strategy to protect their polling lead. Regarding Zema, Kassab considered it a mistake to run for president and suggested he should instead run for the Senate.

item.title: Este filme já passou e no fim o bandido morre. Mas se não morrer?
item.description: The article examines Flávio Bolsonaro's political trajectory, highlighting his shift from a supposedly moderate image to a hardline, anti-establishment stance, promoting draconian punishments and undermining democratic institutions. It warns how bolsonarism exploits public frustration to gain ground, even after consecutive electoral defeats.

item.title: Lula intensifica aceno às mulheres em contraponto a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula intensifies outreach to women with a meeting in Belo Horizonte, while Flávio Bolsonaro faces criticism for allegedly macho positions. A Quaest survey shows Lula leading among female voters (47% vs 35%).

item.title: Propostas de Lula sobre crime organizado seguem emperradas nos EUA
item.description: Cooperation proposals between Brazil and the US on fighting organized crime, presented by Lula to Trump in May, remain unanswered. Despite a phone call on August 21 where Trump expressed willingness, no concrete decisions were made. The issue is prominent in bilateral relations, alongside trade tensions.

item.title: Em debate esvaziado, Lula é citado 40 vezes, a cada 2 minutos em média
item.description: In the first 2026 presidential debate hosted by Band, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was mentioned 40 times on average every two minutes, despite not attending. Candidates Ronaldo Caiado, Renan Santos and Augusto Cury criticized his absence, with Renan labeling him a coward. Flávio Bolsonaro was also attacked, while Romeu Zema was not referenced at all.

item.title: Quem ganhou o primeiro debate presidencial?
item.description: The first presidential debate, hosted by TV Bandeirantes, saw low participation with only three candidates: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Renan Santos (Missão), and Augusto Cury (Avante). Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Romeu Zema did not attend. Despite the limited presence, Renan Santos stood out the most, according to analysts, by leveraging the platform to increase his visibility.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP nesta segunda (23/8)
item.description: On Monday (24/8), seven candidates for São Paulo's 2026 gubernatorial election continue their campaign schedules. Front-runners Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad lead activities including town halls and debates, while other candidates focus on internal strategy meetings and campaign video recordings.

item.title: Após descoberta de petróleo, Alcolumbre é tratado como sheik
item.description: The confirmation of oil in the Amazon mouth strengthened Davi Alcolumbre's position in Congress, where he was nicknamed 'sheikh' by allies. Exploitation could generate billions in royalties and boost Amapá's economy, but creates tensions with environmental ministers. Alcolumbre maintains alliances with LULA and FLÁVIO BOLSONARO, consolidating his political power.

item.title: Lula diz que seu deficit fiscal é melhor que o de Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula claimed that the fiscal deficit and economic indicators under his administration are better than those during Jair Bolsonaro's tenure, highlighting lower deficits, reduced inflation, and higher job creation. He also advocated for a popular economics education program to improve financial management among citizens.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos à Presidência nesta segunda (24/8)
item.description: Presidential candidates have varied schedules across different states with events, meetings, and interviews. Lula stays in Brasília without activities, while Flávio Bolsonaro and others vie for media attention in São Paulo and Minas Gerais.

item.title: Caiado e Renan despontam, Flávio perde força e Lula resiste; Veja reações ao 1º debate presidencial
item.description: In the first presidential debate organized by Grupo Bandeirantes, Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) scored highest in real-time feedback from 12 voters monitored by Instituto Travessia, followed by Renan Santos (Missão). The absence of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro sparked mixed reactions: PT supporters remained loyal, but 2 of 3 Flávio-aligned voters shifted to Caiado, with 1 splitting between Flávio and Renan. The qualitative research involving 12 São Paulo residents from classes B to D is not representative of actual voting intentions.

item.title: Debate da Band: os principais momentos do primeiro confronto entre candidatos à Presidência
item.description: The Band debate featured only three candidates, with Renan Santos from Missão using aggression and performative style to position himself as anti-system. The participants fiercely attacked Lula and Flávio, highlighting a confrontational tone in the first presidential debate.

item.title: Los partidos del gran centro oportunista de Brasil se declaran neutrales en la elección presidencial
item.description: The Centrão parties, known for their ideological flexibility, have adopted a neutral stance for the 2026 presidential election, not endorsing any candidate in advance. This marks a departure from their traditional opportunistic alliance-building. Among the parties mentioned, PT, PSOL, and PL are noted for maintaining fixed ideological positions.

item.title: El poder de la mirada masculina: quién domina el espacio de las mujeres
item.description: The lack of female representation in Brazilian electoral campaigns reflects a gap between women's lived realities and institutional politics, highlighted by international cases showing both progress and setbacks in women's participation in public and private spheres.

item.title: Augusto Cury, Renan Santos e Ronaldo Caiado criticam ausęncia de Lula no debate presidencial
item.description: The first presidential debate of the 2026 elections, broadcast by TV Cultura, featured Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Renan Santos (Missão), and Augusto Cury (Avante), who criticized the absence of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and other candidates like Flávio Bolsonaro and Romeu Zema. Participants took the opportunity to attack the petista administration and present proposals on security, economy, and education.

item.title: Lula e Flávio vencem o debate sem nem aparecer
item.description: The debate on TV Bandeirantes was deemed low quality by the author, who criticizes the absence of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Despite not participating, the candidates won the debate according to the author.

item.title: ESPECIAL ELEIÇÕES: o que esperar das nossas relações com o mundo? - O Assunto #1789
item.description: The special episode of podcast O Assunto #1789 discusses the international relations proposals of the 2026 presidential candidates, focusing on Brazil's position amid commercial and diplomatic pressures from foreign powers, especially the US. Journalist Ricardo Abreu and experts discuss how Brazilian diplomacy can navigate a changing geopolitical order.

item.title: Quando será o próximo debate presidencial da eleição 2026?
item.description: The next presidential debate for the 2026 election is scheduled for September 14th, organized by the Momento da Decisão consortium. Additional debates are planned for September 27th (Record), October 1st (Globo), and October 4th (first round). Some candidates, such as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, chose not to participate in the first debate.

item.title: Lula volta a dizer que Lulinha deve explicar atuação suspeita
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated in an interview with Record that his son Fábio Luiz Lula da Silva must explain his allegedly suspicious activities under investigation by the Federal Police, while stressing he will not interfere with the probes. Lula emphasized that no one is above the law, and his son will be judged, penalized, or acquitted based on evidence. The investigation involves alleged appointments and access to the federal government through lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and former chief of staff Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola.

item.title: Presidenciáveis querem Brasil próximo da Ásia e EUA, fortalecer o Mercosul e deixar o Brics; veja propostas para política externa
item.description: The 2026 presidential candidates propose closer ties with Asia, the US, and Mercosul strengthening, with divergences on the BRICS: Lula supports deeper relations, while Zema wants to leave the bloc.

item.title: Quase 3 em cada 10 candidatos de 2026 são estreantes nas urnas
item.description: TSE data shows that 27.1% of the 20,608 candidates registered for the 2026 elections are newcomers, meaning they have no prior electoral participation since 1994. Most newcomers run for deputy positions, especially district deputy, where 54% of candidates are new. Analysts note that the low presence of newcomers in high-visibility races is due to party leadership favoring established leaders.

item.title: Romeu Zema participa nesta segunda de série de entrevistas da Globo com candidatos a presidente; saiba como assistir
item.description: Romeu Zema, candidate for President from Novo, participates this Monday in TV Globo's interview series live after the National Journal, with broadcasting also on GloboNews, g1 and Globoplay.

item.title: Milei se descola de ex-assessor preso e volta a acusar Lula sem provas
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei distanced himself from former aide Fernando Cerimedo, arrested in Bolivia over an attempted murder of his partner, and without evidence, hinted at a conspiracy involving Lula and other politicians. Milei also repeated baseless accusations against Lula. The Cerimedo case involves an assassination attempt in Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia.

item.title: Lobista diz que Lulinha articulou reuniões na Presidência com Brandão
item.description: Messages from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger suggest that Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, arranged meetings at the Planalto Palace with Maranhão governor Carlos Brandão, promising to advance the release of public works. The Federal Police are investigating suspected influence peddling involving the lobbyist and Lulinha, as well as contracts awarded to private companies with public funds.

item.title: PSD vai propor ida obrigatória a debates, diz Caiado
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) announced that his party will propose making candidate participation in presidential debates mandatory, following the absence of Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Romeu Zema from the Band's first debate. Caiado strongly criticized the absent candidates, stating they harm voters and that their brazen treatment of Brazilian society is unacceptable.

item.title: Ernesto Paglia questiona Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) sobre o combate ao crime no debate presidencial
item.description: In the Band presidential debate, Ernesto Paglia questioned Ronaldo Caiado on governor autonomy, body cameras, and the construction of 40 federal prisons. Caiado criticized the Lula government for allegedly being lenient toward criminal factions and proposed labeling them terrorists, while also deploying the Armed Forces at borders. The PSD candidate highlighted the drop in crime in Goiás and suggested Lincoln Gakiya for the Ministry of Public Security.

item.title: Conheça filmes e séries sobre apostas, como 'Corrida dos Bichos' e 'Jogada de Risco'
item.description: Recent films and series explore themes such as gambling, power, addiction, and violence. Titles like 'Corrida dos Bichos' and 'Jogada de Risco' present different approaches to the world of illegal betting in Brazil. Some productions are available on streaming platforms like Netflix, Prime Video, and Telecine.

item.title: Tarcísio encerra mandato com piora gradativa nas contas e aponta investimento maior em PPPs
item.description: Tarcísio concludes his term as São Paulo governor with a gradual deterioration of fiscal indicators, while emphasizing increased use of public-private partnerships. Folha data suggests his administration left the state economy more vulnerable. His PPP-focused investment strategy was presented as a solution but has been questioned by experts.

item.title: Cury pede desculpas à imprensa por quase não participar de debate
item.description: Augusto Cury apologized for nearly skipping the Band debate after hesitating due to the absence of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Lula and Flávio lead the race with 39% and 33% support, respectively. Candidate participation in debates is voluntary under election law.

item.title: Após não ir a debate, Flávio divulga propostas e critica Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro released government proposals and criticized Lula's administration after skipping the Band debate. He advocated for tax cuts and anti-corruption measures, highlighting insecurity and unemployment as key national issues.

item.title: Como o Chega procura copiar os Bolsonaros
item.description: The Portuguese party Chega seeks to replicate Jair Bolsonaro and Michelle Bolsonaro's strategy to attract conservative voters, particularly evangelicals. The growing political influence of evangelicals in Brazil has served as a model for radical right-wing movements in Europe.

item.title: Lula diz que ligação com Trump foi “boa” e “deu frutos”
item.description: President Lula described his connection with Trump as 'good' and highlighted progress in cooperation, including a new meeting on rare earths and balanced trade. He rejected raw material exports, proposing local transformation to produce cell phones and batteries, while Brazil contests US tariffs of 25% and 12.5%.

item.title: Fraldas, ofensas e ausências: o resumo do primeiro debate entre candidatos a presidente
item.description: The first presidential debate was marked by the absence of major candidates, with attacks focused on Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Renan Santos adopted an aggressive posture, using diapers and insults, while other candidates had limited participation.

item.title: 6x1, segurança e Zema poupado: veja como foi 1º debate presidencial
item.description: The first 2026 presidential debate, hosted by Band, featured only three candidates: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Renan Santos (Missão), and Augusto Cury (Avante). Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Zema did not attend, with the former two facing criticism for disrespecting Brazilians. Topics discussed included the 6x1 work schedule and public security proposals.

item.title: Após faltar a debate, Flávio Bolsonaro destaca ausência de Lula: ‘Quero debater com meu adversário’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Lula and Zema's absence from the first 2026 electoral debate, stating he wants to debate only with the president. He emphasized issues like tax reduction and fighting criminal factions, but did not consider other candidates his opponents.

item.title: O candidato que ficou esquecido durante os três blocos do debate na Band
item.description: During the Band TV debate, Augusto Cury (Avante), Renan Santos (Missao), and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Lula and Flavio Bolsoniro but did not mention Romeu Zema, who withdrew due to Lula's absence. Zema's campaign justified the withdrawal because the debate date was moved from August 16 to August 23 with the expectation that Lula would participate.

item.title: Ausente, Lula vira principal alvo de ataques de presidenciáveis, que deixam Flávio em 2º plano
item.description: In his first 2026 presidential debate, Lula became the target of attacks from Caiado, Cury, and Renan Santos, while Flávio Bolsonaro and Romeu Zema were absent. Renan highlighted PT scandals and called Lula 'scoundrel', 'drunk', and 'scoundrel'. The absence of main candidates sparked criticism and speculation about their relevance in the race.

item.title: Crusoé: Renan aparece e Zema se enterra no debate na Band
item.description: In the Bandeirantes debate, minor candidates had space to position themselves, while Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro avoided direct confrontation. Renan Santos, from Missão, stood out by actively participating, while other candidates had less visibility. The event mainly served for side participants to gain relevance in the electoral scenario.

item.title: Em debate, Caiado diz que aumentará autonomia dos governadores na segurança pública
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, a PSD presidential candidate, stated in a debate that he will increase the autonomy of state governors in public security management, prioritizing decisions aligned with each state's specific realities.

item.title: Em entrevista, Lula afirma que vai anunciar o fim da taxa das blusinhas
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced in an interview with TV Record that he will eliminate the 20% tax on international purchases up to $50. The measure aims to reduce consumer costs and boost foreign trade.

item.title: Renan Santos: eleição é jogo de cartas marcadas mandado pelo Master
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from Missão, claimed in a debate that the 2026 election is 'a rigged game' with Banco Master as the 'mastermind'. He also suggested that Lula's reelection could lead to the release of banker Daniel Vorcaro, arrested during the petista's third term.

item.title: Lula diz que conversa com Trump já deu frutos e espera que sejam 'bem saborosos'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said his call with Donald Trump has already yielded benefits and hopes the outcomes will be positive. He emphasized the importance of international relations. The statement comes amid the 2026 campaign context.

item.title: Flávio falta a debate e critica Lula: 'Quem está lá não é meu adversário'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro did not attend the Band debate and posted a video on Instagram during the event, criticizing Lula and stating that the attending candidates are not his opponents. He chose not to directly face the other candidates in the debate, reinforcing his position that his main opponent is Lula.

item.title: VÍDEO: Vice de Caiado, Kassab é flagrado dormindo durante debate na Band
item.description: During the presidential debate on TV Bandeirantes, PSD national president and vice-presidential candidate Gilberto Kassab was caught sleeping, including while his running mate Ronaldo Caiado spoke. The debate featured only three candidates, with confirmed absences from Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Romeu Zema.

item.title: Coadjuvantes na disputa levam nomes de Lula e Flávio a debate com insulto, promessa e palestrinha
item.description: The debate organized by Band and Estadão took place without the presence of Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Zema, who were the main names in the race. Supporting candidates Ronaldo Caiado, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury filled the empty pulpits with criticism, radical promises, and aggressive speeches, using the absence of leaders to gain visibility. Renan launched a campaign rejecting votes from Lula-aligned voters, while Cury positioned himself as a conciliatory figure.
